GZIP is a widely used data compression format, especially in web transfers. It uses the DEFLATE algorithm to compress data, significantly reducing file sizes.

Key features:
1. High compression ratio - typically 70-90% for text files
2. Wide support - almost all browsers and servers support GZIP
3. Fast decompression - very fast, suitable for real-time transfers
